title: Manson's War
overview: Beyond the flatland's where the Spahn Ranch once stood a gathering of Charles Manson devotees find refuge in the woods. When a member of their group is brutally attacked they are forced to take revenge.

title: Escape From Letterkenny
overview: A Metalhead makes a deal with God...  This film follows the intertwining meanderings of some typical Letterkenny residents over a few highly eventful days. Some are good, some are bad, some are morally vague. All are trapped in the same town. This film is about getting out. It's about breaking the shackles that hold you back by any means necessary, even if that means embracing utter chaos. It's about standing up to your outer demon. It's about friendship. It's about blossoming love. It's about dodgy-looking drugs. It will wreck your head. Or at the very least, it will make you question what kind of God you have.

title: Promises
overview: A film director meets his ex-wife after a long separation. As they spend time together, old promises begin to lose the meaning they once had.

title: High in the Clouds
overview: After he accidentally sparked a revolution against Gretsch, the bossy diva-owl who has banned all music from his town, a teenage squirrel named Wirral embarks on an extraordinary journey to set music free.

title: The Final Hour
overview: A group of friends find themselves trapped in a deadly situation as a mysterious killer begins hunting them one by one during the final hour.

title: Carl Sagan: We Are Made of Star Stuff
original_title: Carl Sagan: We Are Made of Star Stuff
overview: An intimate and cinematic portrait of astronomer and planetary scientist Carl Sagan.

title: REEL
overview: After a late-night slasher screening, a group of horror-loving friends find themselves trapped in a terrifying game where slasher movie rules become reality. As eerie events unfold, they realize someone is rewriting the genre—forcing them to fight for survival in a film that’s still being written. The only way out? Break the rules before it’s too late.

title: What Happened to Doris?
overview: In 1974 LA suburbs, a single mom faces violent attacks by an invisible entity. When no one believes her, she seeks help from paranormal investigators, sparking a notorious documented supernatural case.

title: River
overview: After the death of their father, three siblings take a boat trip to spread their dad's ashes. However, they discover they have inadvertently stumbled onto the hunting grounds of a strange pair of masked killers, and must fight for their lives on a busted motorboat.

title: Angel
overview: When a sex worker is consumed by the life of drugs and partying, accidentally overdosing, she embarks on a journey to better her life.

title: Holly
overview: Holly arrives at church to pray for protection and  is greeted by an entity that craves her innocence.

title: Ray Gunn
overview: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

title: The Perfect Warrior
overview: On a remote island deep in the Orange Sea, an elite clan of warriors called the Totomé train and fight to keep peace among their lands. Every 100 years the top warriors compete to see who will take over as leader, or Abeoji. Katana and Sai are given this opportunity, but when their forbidden relationship is discovered their final challenge to become the leader is to fight in a Si Dou— a sword fight to the death.

title: Ode (An Acknowledgement of Sea Country)
overview: Ode is a cameraless animation made from handmade macroalgae celluloid. Developed with CSIRO and marine scientists, it uses contact printing, botanicollage, and seaweed bio-sonification to explore post-petrochemical cinema. Lasting 365 seconds, the film offers an ocean-responsive meditation on deep time, material intelligence, and more-than-human collaboration.

title: Whiddy
overview: A small rural community in Ireland welcomes in a major, global oil company with open arms but just 10 years and numerous oil spills later, that dream turns into an unimaginable nightmare. 50 lives lost in a tragedy that silenced and divided the community and still haunts it to this day.

title: The Death of Marion Wayne
overview: Marion Wayne is a chaotic gunslinger traveling the country with his small gang. When he gets captured by the law he learns of an indifference of power within the law, and upon breaking out of prison he pursues a revenge arc to balance the system.

title: Red Ink
overview: In post-WWII New York, media propaganda, institutional power, and exploitation are interrogated amid the looming threat of a mysterious global virus.

title: Lizzie
overview: A young woman, Eliza, returns to her hometown for summer break, and must confront a fragment of her past.

title: Scream: Short Film
overview: After a brutal murder reawakens Woodsboro's dark past, Cora Clemenzo is pulled into a new Ghostface killing spree as her friends in the Woodsboro High Cinema Club become suspects and survival means uncovering the truth before history repeats itself...

title: My Duchess
overview: Telling the story of the final years of the woman who married King Edward VIII and broke up the monarchy.

title: A Woman Asleep
overview: Inspired by A Man Asleep by Georges Perec, A Woman Asleep explores contemporary alienation in a world of constant connection and endless information. Following a shifting group of women, the film uses synthetic imagery and the director’s own voice clone to reflect a society that keeps looking, yet no longer truly sees or feels. Based on an semi-autobiographical original script, A Woman Asleep takes an essayistic form, echoing Resnais, Marker, Antonioni, and Akerman as fiction, memory, and reflection blur.

title: Heathens
overview: A groundbreaking 2024 University of Chicago study, presented at the Society for the Scientific Study of Religion, has uncovered something stunning: more than 50 million American Christians now conceal private doubts about their faith—a quiet crisis of doubt hidden behind Sunday smiles. This nationally representative research—the first of its kind—reveals the emotional and social toll of concealment: anxiety, shame, family rupture, and the quiet unraveling of identity in communities where belief defines belonging.

title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
original_title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
overview: It's a matter of life and death for Alison, Mike, Mia and the Ghosts.

title: SYNTHETICA
overview: Ada, a retired hacker living quietly as an art curator, discovers an illegal neural implant in their head after experiencing dangerous memory glitches. When an underground surgeon can't safely remove it, Ada is forced to accept one last job: infiltrate the corporation that created the device. As the mission unfolds, Ada must confront the truth about their forgotten past and the real purpose of the technology buried in their mind.

title: The Virgins
overview: Two straight-A high school girls break free for a secret weekend, unknowingly attracting the attention of two angry young men.

title: Private Restroom
overview: Under the skin of every city lies a thick layer of crime, managed globally by an unlikely front: Private Restrooms. They aren't hidden beneath the surface, but in plain sight-where you see them every day, yet never look close enough...

title: Klara and the Sun
overview: When Klara, an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home, meets Josie, each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother and they've suffered great loss, but Klara's innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie's complicated world.

title: Remnant
overview: Ten years ago, Anna’s father disappeared, a fugitive wanted for mass murder. Two days ago, her estranged mother mysteriously died. But when Anna inherits her childhood home, a malicious demonic presence forces her to confront the terrifying truth of her family legacy.

title: The flash drive killer case
overview: This Mockumentary horror about officers find flash drive in the park And it was found that there were 3 video clips that were less than 1 minute long, as follows Video 1 Joe Possessed by a ghost and hit on the head into the wall Video 2 a curse movie film scene and Video 3 show William O Jack got shot by Fred and police found out Fred is the owner of that flash drive and the how the flash drive killer case was begin.

title: Where's Your Sunset Spot?
overview: David, a gay high school senior, embarks on an end-of-summer road trip with his best friend Annie. Along the way, he begins to question what he thought he understood about his identity.

title: Always Lalisa
overview: Documentary following global superstar LISA during a transformative year away from BLACKPINK, the K-pop phenomenon that made her one of the world's most recognizable performers. Documenting a year of risk, reinvention, and self-discovery as LISA begins to define her next chapter.

title: Roof
overview: Trapped on the roof of a skyscraper over a holiday weekend and without communication, two co-workers attempt to escape in increasingly dangerous ways as their health deteriorates while both realize how much they have ruined their lives.

title: Brotherhood: A Cinematic Musical
overview: "Brotherhood" tells the story of two next-door neighbors: Jon, a white US citizen, and Fabián, a Mexican immigrant who learn what it means to be American and to love your neighbor.

title: Hoodsteps
overview: This is the debut work of “Wosaka,” the globally popular character from the Republic of Tuktue, and the masterpiece of director Nomura Fusso, known as the ”father or mother of stop-motion animation.” The protagonist, Nomura, is an ordinary office worker at a company that manufactures adhesive bandages. One day, a face named Wosaka appears on the sole of her foot and starts moving around as it pleases. Wosaka puts on a suit, Nomura is forced to put on a shoe on her face, and they head to work upside down. As a result, the city descends into chaos! What is Wosaka’s purpose? Can Nomura return to normal?

title: H.D.I.D.T.B.A.L.
overview: A woman has an existential crisis when she's asked out by a woman for the first time. What should she wear that shows her true self?

title: Subscriber
overview: An obnoxious real estate YouTuber takes his crew to a dilapidated farmhouse in Ohio, one of his recent purchases. Once they enter the remote house, they learn there is an entity not of this earth that refuses to let them leave…

title: Beware Boiúna
overview: A medical mission deep in the Amazon becomes a desperate fight for survival when a colossal ancient predator awakens, turning the jungle into a deadly battleground where nature decides who lives and dies.

title: Digger
overview: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

title: SHED
overview: Becca Novak, a successful but isolated young woman stalked by grief, is haunted inside her own body – until a final, brutal revelation shatters everything she thought she knew about herself.

title: Birds of Paradise
overview: Two jealous, self-critical birds admire a macho bird from afar, wishing they could be more like him... but the "perfect" image they're comparing themselves to isn't what it seems.

title: Invention 13
overview: On a cold, windy night, a frustrated pianist encounters strange obstacles while trying to learn  Bach's notoriously intricate Invention 13.

title: Sugar Laced
overview: Lemonia is the owner of the most popular bakery in town, but the genius behind her most  sought-after goods is not her, but her new employee, Margarita. Margarita's repertoire  includes many types of desserts, the most renowned being her hyper realistic cakes made to  look nothing like sweets. They imitate cuts of meat, but imitation can only go so far...

title: Other I
overview: An impoverished girl ventures to a temple to seek charity from a capricious angel.

title: + Add Friend
overview: A working man must confront his secret shame as his online activity unravels into his personal life- following an intimate encounter with an anonymous internet user.

title: No Limbs No Limits
overview: The powerful true story of world-renowned speaker Nick Vujicic—a man who has defined what it means to live without limits. This film is more than a documentary; it’s a testament to resilience, faith, and the unstoppable human spirit. Born without arms or legs, Nick overcame his disability to live not just independently but a rich, fulfilling life, becoming a model for anyone seeking true happiness.

title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
original_title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
overview: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

title: Jelly Baddies
overview: Jelly Baddies make new friends, Jelly Baddies having fun.

title: Baby Daddy
overview: A lonely three-year-old pulls out a chunk of his dad's beard, plants it in the garden, and grows a new best friend.

title: Shadows of Beirut
overview: A young woman decides to return to Beirut to see her estranged dying father after 25 years. Between the struggle to forgive him and building up the courage to face him, she discovers the heart of her homeland through the people she meets.

title: Rahul & Rosa
overview: Strange things happen to Rahul and Rosa as their relationship falls apart.

title: UNABOMBER
overview: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.

title: The Deputy
overview: A young sheriff's deputy finds himself in the crosshairs of dangerous criminals when the dead body he is assigned to keep an eye on disappears from a crime scene.

title: Beneath It All
overview: Between takes on her first feature film, actress Remi is suddenly given direction that could significantly alter the course of her life. With only ten minutes to decide whether or not to stand up to the director, the film takes an unexpected turn.

title: Dogwood
overview: "DOGWOOD" is a tale of survival, revenge, and the enduring strength of a mother's love as Harriet confronts the darkest depths of human nature to protect what is rightfully hers.

title: XYZ
overview: A man cannot figure out why everyone is staring at him...

title: Roll Over and Play Dead
overview: I don't know much about truth but I do know how to obey. And that's what I love to do; kiss ass, roll over, play dead.

title: Fit Check
overview: A man sees a mannequin dressed exactly like him.

title: Thief of Night
overview: By stealing the beautiful night scenery by heart, thieves understand the pure love and embracement.

title: Mortal Lace
overview: Mortal Lace depicts existence as a conscious hallucination created by our own experience of life. This is explored through the context of a week where each day progress closer to absolute reality.

title: The Maggots
overview: Yinfeng’s abusive father is seriously ill when she is far away from home. What will she do about this blood relationship that has caused her so much pain?

title: Chow Time
overview: In pursuit of the perfect meal, Brighton goes to battle with his six roommates over control of the kitchen.

title: The Swallow
overview: Ziggy and her four friends journey out on a camping trip to a picturesque remote forest. But trespassing into an off-limits area, they awaken an uncanny terror in the woods... and a ravenous hunger from within the Earth. Soon, the ground itself is trying to swallow anything and anyone it comes into contact with and Ziggy and her friends have nowhere to run as every trembling step they take could be their last.

title: The Florist
overview: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

title: Knowing Gaze
overview: Knowing Gaze is a loving roast of gay culture. This animated short moves fluidly through a series of interconnected vignettes—from online personas to offline hookups, from the thrift store to the dance floor to the bathhouse.  Rendered in expressive brush strokes, the story unfolds as candid conversations carried by acidic dialogue and vulnerable interior monologues. At its core, the film probes the tenderness and tension of modern gay identity. Beneath a million witty one-liners, the soul cries out.

title: Creatures
overview: In Amsterdam, a queer Polish tattoo artist creates creatures that become part of other people's bodies. Through fandoms, online communities, and kindred spirits, we explore the world surrounding the artist, Pazur Mazur.

title: MAN or MOUNTAIN
overview: Defying evacuation orders and denying scientific evidence, notorious lodge owner Harry R. Truman is sent cascading through memories of a life lived without regret beneath Mt. St. Helens, as mounting tremors rock his cherished world.  Still basking in the limelight of his rebellion, imminent cataclysm forces him to finally face the truth of his grave decision: to be destroyed by what he loved.

title: Dance Film
overview: This short animated film playfully upends the history of avant garde choreography films by focusing its attention on the spectator of a dance instead of the dancer herself (the filmmaker, Kelly). In some ways it's about watching others watching and what it means to become conscious of our own role as spectators. In other ways it's just a colorful film about a very happy baby watching with delight as her mother dances.

title: Sense and Sensibility
overview: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.

title: Cop This
overview: It's Grand Final Day and in a suburban police station about to be replaced by an AI 'Terminal', the two remaining cops (Nicolette Minster and Ray O'Leary) are tasked with babysitting a drug dealer for 24 hours.

title: Muurbloem
overview: Four of Madelief's best friends join her for dinner. They take a trip down memory lane, while she listens. But as the night continues, her friends push her closer to an uncomfortable reality. Whether's she's ready for it or not.

title: I Don’t Love You Anymore
overview: In a Niagara Falls motel, an unremarkable couple attempts a romantic getaway. But as the days go by, the trip threatens to turn into a cold shower. I Don’t Love You Anymore is a humorous exploration of the red flags we choose to ignore to keep a relationship alive.

title: This Is Our City
overview: The ambitious son of a ruthless mob boss hires a film crew, who end up being undercover FBI agents, to document his life as a dysfunctional and delusional gangster.

title: Nimesh Patel: Buy The Dip
overview: In his first Netflix special, Nimesh Patel talks rebelling against his traditional parents and why you should never go viral in India.

title: Harmony Korine is A Weird Old Man
original_title: Harmony Korine is A Weird Old Man
overview: A four part ambiguation of "weirdness" in relation to the sublime. A sensory ode to incongruity. A brief and romantic gesture toward un-understanding. A prayer to the anti-self.

title: Hair Fetish Killer
overview: Documents the murder, in which Heather Barnett was found with two clumps of precisely trimmed hair in her hands, and which led detectives to Italy. It took eight years before the discovery of a second victim, Elisa Claps, finally led police to the killer.

title: Protein: Everything You Need to Know
original_title: Protein: Everything You Need to Know
overview: From protein pitfalls to considered choices, Gemma Atkinson, Dr Jack Mosley and Lucy Watson cut through the hype to discover the truth about the consumer health obsession

title: Spidernado
overview: A quiet countryside is plunged into chaos when a monstrous tornado tears across the region—only to reveal something far worse riding in its winds.

title: Headscarf
overview: Chemotherapy leaves Candela feeling undesirable and unseen. To brave love again, she must confront her shame and reclaim her femininity.

title: Keirra
overview: A lonely student, raised under her mother’s suffocating control, finds love and confidence through a film that finally lets her be seen. But when a humiliating video is exposed, her breakdown becomes a reckoning — and the girl who wanted attention learns what it means to be unforgettable.

title: Stitches
overview: Three isolated men submit to rituals of healing—an AI cleanse, a live stream of penance, and an experimental drug trial—each descending into madness as their pain becomes performance in a world obsessed with watching.

title: Pathetic Fallacy
overview: A grieving young widower seeks healing in a spiritual mountain town but encounters a bizarre murderer and demonic forest spirits who offer him the power to cheat death at a terrifying cost.

title: Jeffrey's Turn
overview: Jeffrey’s Turn based on a true life story of a young Mi’kmag man, Collin Sylliboy on the cusp of adulthood who embarks on a life changing road trip with an almost mythic figure from his past; his uncle Buck. Heeding an urgent call from his uncle, Collin has an adventure that opens his eyes to his Uncle’s tragic past of false incarceration stemming from generations of racism.  As the road unwinds, together they overcome the obstacles that are thrust in their way both externally and internally by ghosts from his uncle’s dark past. With grim determination and humor these two men bond together forever marking young Collin as he finally steps into manhood.  Jeffrey’s Turn with its universal message of coming to terms with your past while learning to live in the present is both hopeful but realistic in its portrayal of living as a Mi’kmag man in today’s society

title: Sparks
overview: Two late-20s Londoners walk home from their first date and see the exact life they will have if they pursue the sparks between them.

title: The Second Assignment
overview: A film student in the midst of a moral crisis struggles to come up with a concept for his next short film.

title: Aftercare
overview: A couple is forced to face the reality of their relationship when a storm keeps them from leaving.

title: Posthumous
overview: After returning to her childhood home, Zoe discovers a mysterious videotape that unravels everything she thought she knew about her birth and her mother's death, awakening an unimaginable horror.

title: Kill Me Now
overview: A writer on a deadline to finish her first Hollywood thriller seeks solace in her home. Life imitates art as she becomes convinced her neighbor is going to kill her.

title: Peculiar Green
overview: A middle-aged man with deity-like powers details the creation of his new world. A world characterized by a shade of green.

title: CHASING RAHUL
overview: In modern-day Bangalore, Sama sets on to chase the old-school romance she grew up believing in, all while discovering the little beauties of Bangalore city.

title: lucid
overview: The nightmare-plagued protagonist attempts to use lucid dreaming to break free from a surreal cycle.

title: Pulp: What Do You Do for an Encore?
original_title: Pulp: What Do You Do for an Encore?
overview: A fusion of the brilliantly choreographed stage spectacle of Pulp’s biggest ever arena show — part of the global tour for More, the band’s first album in 24 years — with four decades of colorful, never-seen-before archival material.

title: TEENAGERS
overview: Six old friends gather at Megan’s house for a quiet reunion while her parents are away. What begins as a casual night of music, drinks, and nostalgia quickly becomes tense as old memories resurface and the group dynamic begins to fracture. As the night goes on, an unsettling feeling takes hold, turning the familiar setting into something increasingly dangerous.

title: Sweetest Day
overview: ‘Survivor girl’ Mindy prepares for the battle of her life against the undead confederate soldier that nearly killed her once before.

title: Stranger Things Have Happened to Me
original_title: Stranger Things Have Happened to Me
overview: Antonio is jealous of his new teammate, Stephon, who has kindled a connection with his girlfriend Mya. His anger fuels the fire that stirs up hidden truths and unravels a long list of lies and deception causing chaos around the college campus.

title: The Mini Chainsaw Massacre
overview: While driving a forgotten back road, a young couple is forced into a brutal fight for survival against a chainsaw-wielding madman.

title: Mackenzie
overview: Eleven-year-old Juniper runs away from home and sets out across the Utah desert, determined to reach California and marry her television crush, Mackenzie Astin. Along the way, her unlikely journey becomes a search for connection, independence, and a place to belong.

title: Best of the Best
overview: Two childhood besties join UCLA's competitive Bollywood-fusion dance team, only to find the road to the US championships is fiercer than they imagined.

title: Windows of Time
overview: A divine vision inspired Hubert Taylor to pick up a home video camera and spend decades documenting the life of his Georgia hometown. His gaze keeps returning to his own father, the gospel singer Brother Theotis Taylor, whose legendary falsetto took him to Carnegie Hall. With co-director and music archivist Cyrus Moussavi, he unearths an unseen community archive and shapes it into a moving meditation on art, family, community, and legacy.

title: Daniel and the Fiery Furnace
overview: During the Jewish exile to Babylon, Daniel and his friends face trials as Babylon's armies conquer Jerusalem. Under King Nebuchadnezzar, they gain royal favor but make enemies. Their faith is tested at the fiery furnace.

title: Occupational Hazard: The First Coral Reefers
original_title: Occupational Hazard: The First Coral Reefers
overview: Journey through the 1970s and early ’80s with the original members of Jimmy Buffett's Coral Reefer Band as they recount their contributions to iconic albums, life on tour, and the lasting impact they had in shaping a unique and enduring genre of music.

title: I Have Proof
overview: Plot details are being kept locked in an old VCR, but the film is said to be psychologically charged, and favor 'texture, imperfection, and immediacy over polish'.

title: Into the Sky
overview: A man's efforts to win back his wife keep getting derailed when aliens mysteriously snatch him from Earth, making his path to reconciliation a lot more complicated than expected.

title: Rain was Not in the Forecast
original_title: Rain was Not in the Forecast
overview: Cole Front gets a visit from his old partner and lover, Gail Storm. Does she plan to save the climate, or to catch her old flame in a weather trap?

title: Zippy's House
overview: A troubled teen is forced to attend his strange classmate's birthday.

title: We Must Begin Again, Together
overview: When a woman discovers her husband is having an affair with her brother, the double betrayal breaks her world open. But in a small, conservative town where identity is policed and secrets work for survival, she’s pushed toward an unexpected path.

title: Phreaker
overview: Inspired by true events. Before there were hackers, there were phreakers. A blind teenager joins the early underworld of "phone freaks" where he learns to hack his way to money, power, and eventually, a place on the FBI's most wanted list.

title: The Art of Trying
overview: Antonio chose to leave a life of crime behind him after 25 years. He is now homeless and wandering around the same crime-ridden streets trying to make an honest living as a painter.

title: OLDSKIN/NEWDRUGS
overview: The narrator is a girl. This is mid-July. She's feeling weird. She goes outside.

title: We Set the House on Fire
original_title: We Set the House on Fire
overview: Five strangers happen upon a mysterious house on New Years Eve, their secrets and connections begin to be uncovered as the night takes a supernatural turn.

title: Midnight Murungai
overview: A downbeat Toronto-Tamil millennial finds her plan for a free-house is thwarted by her kooky Mom who is acting suspicious.

title: The Long Way to Tipperary
overview: A man returns home.

title: 70 Up
overview: Across seven decades, British viewers watched 14 children grow into adults in films broadcast every seven years. In the series' final installment – with all surviving participants now in their seventies – what do their lives tell us about Britain?

title: Run Hide Fight: Infidels
overview: When radical Islamist terrorists hijack a liberal college's pro-Palestine encampment, a ragtag band of red-blooded students, a security guard, and a Delta Force vet must arm up to save their clueless peers.

title: The Last Kiss
overview: A young woman discovers she can foresee the death of anyone she kisses, and when a vision predicts her crush will die in a murder spree targeting her closest friends, she races to uncover the killer before more lives are lost.

title: The World Is A Wedding
overview: A teenager joins his grandmother at a mahjong game, where he encounters a mysterious woman threatening to unravel secrets from their family's past.

title: Sunlight Water
overview: When a lonely, recently single woman rescues a houseplant in need of serious TLC – and then falls in love with it – she must discover what the plant really wants, or risk losing herself forever.

title: Madeon: There Is No Band
overview: Ahead of a landmark performance at Red Rocks, we followed Madeon behind the scenes as he prepared to unveil an entirely new era of his career. From the earliest concepts and production of the show to rehearsals, visual effects, and the final preparations before taking the stage, this documentary gives an inside look at the creative process behind bringing his new vision to life.

title: Future Tense
overview: Cape Town, South Africa. In a near future on the brink of climate collapse, Lwando and his girlfriend Tara are among the privileged few who win the opportunity to travel back to 1647 and a pre-colonial past to experience nature in its wildest form. Lwando is an underground activist who dreams of changing the course of history. Tara wants to save her relationship with him. Together, the couple must choose whether to risk life as they know it for a potentially better world.

title: The Phone Booth
overview: A man is anxiously waiting for a pay phone to ring, while a dark presence is observing close-by.

title: Lemonade
overview: Danny, a kind-hearted teen about to age out of the care system is facing adulthood without family or support. After a turbulent childhood and separation from his younger brother, Danny is determined to build a future - but one reckless mistake puts him at risk of prison. As his 18th birthday approaches, Josh - his former social worker and the only adult who ever believed in him - returns, offering guidance when Danny needs it most. With new love, big dreams, and overwhelming challenges, Danny must choose whether to repeat the cycle of his past or fight for the life he deserves.

title: Whatcha Want
overview: When a young trophy wife and recent immigrant from Hong Kong uncovers her wealthy husband's betrayal, she reignites her passion for dance, forcing her to choose between the life she was given and the liberation she longs for.

title: Purgatory
overview: In the early 1980s, 13-year-old Beatrice Gravel's comfortable world—family, school, and church—fractures when her mother moves out to 'self actualize', leaving Beatrice and her younger sister Chloe with their devastated father. As Beatrice doubles down on a plan to 'fix' her family, she barrels through bullies, friendship blowups, a make-out party, and a kleptomaniac babysitter—forcing her to decide who she wants to be when she can’t get what she wants.

title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
original_title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
overview: A seventy year old widow recovers from a stroke in the care of his dysfunctional family. While his body is failing him, his libido still rages on – unwittingly sparked by the attentions of his daughter-in-law, a dancer with a shady past.

title: Trash Mountain
overview: A twenty something gay man travels from Chicago to his home in rural Missouri following the death of his father — an obsessive hoarder who has left a house full of items, some valuable and some not so, to pick through.

title: Black Forest
overview: Jack and Alice find a video camera while hiking in the woods. As he reviews the footage, Jack’s sanity is pushed to the limits as the people he watches calls out to him looking for his soul.

title: This Time, I Mean It
overview: This Time, I Mean It, is a Comedy Drama that follows the story of Sam, who must fight against time to stop his girlfriend from leaving his life forever.

title: Faith
overview: Gina, a hard-working and devoted single mother, meets a quietly enigmatic stranger, Michael. The presence of someone who appears to care for her brings a new and exciting dynamic to her life, despite the fact she knows nothing about him or what his intentions towards her really are. Is he a friend, a potential lover or something more sinister?

title: Wired Together
overview: Ivy and Alex are two normal people who happened to fall in love at first sight in the library. Neither of them knew the toll and effect the other's presence, or lack thereof, would have on their life. As they enter the first major challenge of their relationship, long distance, they must accept that sometimes things do change.

title: What Love Builds
overview: Follows Crowe's passion for music and his efforts of maintaining it alongside his acting career, showcasing him and his band on their recent tour in Europe, as well as previous shows in the US, UK and Australia.

title: The Face of Horror
overview: In medieval England, the beautiful Eleanor pines away for her errant husband, the handsome but adulterous knight Edward. title: Mel

title: The Ringing

title: Rent in Peace

title: Final Transmissions

title: She Saw Us

title: Against The Skin

title: Katô: Dreams of Dark Earth
overview: Katô follows the Munduruku through their decades-long struggle for land and clean water, revealing a world where daily survival is an act of resistance.  Refusing to wait for government recognition, the community has taken up the mantle of self-demarcation, putting their bodies on the line to map their own return. Supporting them is a women-led video collective that transforms cameras into visual arrows, documenting the destruction while affirming a vitality that cannot be extracted. By reclaiming the Katô—the ancestral Dark Earth—the Munduruku remind us that the soil is a living witness. Their fight for the land is not merely local; it is a desperate defense of the lungs of Mother Earth, upon which all life depends.

title: Eternity One
overview: ETERNITY ONE follows Mary Ella, a young girl growing up on Tangier Island in the Chesapeake Bay, where rising seas have already claimed two-thirds of the land and threaten to erase what remains. Once a thriving fishing community, Tangier now faces the collapse of both home and livelihood.

title: The Absence of No
overview: A sexual assault allegation at a university forces those involved and the audience to confront how quickly assumptions and appearances can distort our understanding of the truth.

title: Clyde Saxophone in: The Lick of Death
original_title: Clyde Saxophone in: The Lick of Death

Laugh, cry, vomit, and piss yourself just a little bit in this breakout classic from award-winning directors Dan Griffiths and Magnus Paulak

title: BLOODLINE: HUNT OR BE HUNTED

title: The Headliner

As they clash over the soul of their music, they must unite to fight corporate greed and protect the artistic integrity of the culture.

title: Meeting Your Maker

Meeting Your Maker is a darkly whimsical and deeply emotional short film that follows Otis, a beloved puppet on a long-running children’s show, as he faces an existential crisis just before the series’ milestone 300th episode.  Set against the vibrant chaos of a TV studio and the surreal backdrop of a puppeteer’s inner world, the story explores themes of identity, burnout, and the creative struggle, blurring the line between performer and creator in (hopefully) poignant and unexpectedly funny ways.

title: Horny For Justice IV

It invites audiences into a world where survival depends on silence, and one young girl must decide whether to remain in her mother's chaos or step into her own uncertain freedom.

title: Dream Synth™

But when machines begin to dream, humanity must acknowledge what they’ve given up: dreams were more than random neural firings, they were the essence of consciousness.

title: tempus fugit
overview: Can we keep something as it was, or are we clinging to what must inevitably vanish, despite our efforts to preserve it? "tempus fugit" wrestles with this question, through the exploration of vacant spaces: the filmmaker's family home — vacant after her grandmother's recent passing, a cryonics facility where the dead are frozen for possible revival, and in a composting bin, where worms decompose organic matter. Playing with horror, not as a genre, but as a method, the film contemplates the tensions, and possible harmonies, between rot and preservation.

title: brain_rot_vol1.mp4

title: Algorithmic Nudes Grapple with Entropy

title: Panic in Nowhere
overview: Drifting through videoclips online easily leaves you distracted, lost, and back on square one. Imagine, you found a series of clips organized by a sense of inchoate feeling of eclipse of time and end of the world, evoking a shared sense of fate.

As their lives intertwine once more, the two discover that inspiration is not found in deadlines or demand - but in the timeless values of home, heritage, and hope.
